segments.text: Conference programs drift: an unreviewed proposal, an unfinished speaker task, a schedule change nobody sees. Program Cue brings those signals into one operating picture. Run the program, not the spreadsheet.
From call for speakers to the timetable in an attendee’s pocket, every change has a status, an owner and a next action. Start with the one that matters now.

The Command Centre reads program records, not a parallel checklist. Readiness stays transparent, critical conditions stay named, and “Do this next” links to the filtered critical work. One signal becomes one clear action.

Set dates, venue, timezone, access and brand once. Those choices carry into applications, speaker workspaces, the public program and email. Use Program Cue’s default data store, or select Airtable explicitly when connected. Branding stays private until publication.

Build a conditional call-for-speakers form, preview the applicant experience on desktop and mobile, then publish an immutable version. Applicants recover private drafts; final submissions stay tied to the exact published version reviewers see.

Keep proposal, rubric, conflict check and queue together. Reviewers own their recommendation and can explicitly return work they cannot review. Advisory AI stays off until an administrator opts in; final decisions stay with authorised organisers.

Acceptance links each session, participant role and onboarding task. Speaker, Moderator and Chair responses stay independent. Outstanding work remains visible, while uploads stay quarantined until a clean scan releases them.

After the critical session deliverable, the assistant finds a separate handbook task. It prepares a draft reminder for one recipient and waits for approval. Approval publishes the candidate, records durable queue work, and the requester records focused feedback.

Preview each versioned message’s merge values, sender and audience before confirmation. Then follow queue acceptance and provider result separately. Calendar invitations retain stable identity across create, update and cancel.

Catch the room clash before publication. Save a named Scenario Lab selection without changing the active draft; approve the exact content revision, inspect the full diff, revalidate public dependencies, publish explicitly, then retain the latest digest.

Seven connected examples show the published program across desktop and mobile, including speaker and gallery surfaces, an itinerary and a managed embed. Separately published site content adds the wider event story; every example reads current published data.

Thirty-three documented REST paths, scoped keys and signed webhooks connect the event stack. Operation Centre traces failures and eligible retries against original intent. In this film, Accelevents stops at mapping preview; an authorised organiser must still confirm export.
From first proposal to the timetable in an attendee’s pocket, Program Cue gives program work a shared source, visible ownership and a clear next move. Make the program happen at Program Cue dot com.
